Health

The pinned Lucide subset, for the CLI and test tooling.

### GET /api/status
Overall health plus a per-device summary.

|---|---|---|---|
| device_id | query | False | string |
| timezone | query | False | string |

## lock
### GET /api/lock/requirements
Lock Requirements

### GET /api/lock/status
Whether the app is locked right now. Always reachable.

| name | in | required | type |
|---|---|---|---|
| findplus_session | cookie | False | string |

### POST /api/lock/lock
Lock immediately (manual button, or the client's idle timer).

| name | in | required | type |
|---|---|---|---|
| findplus_session | cookie | False | string |

### POST /api/lock/unlock
Exchange a correct PIN for a session cookie. Rate-limited.

**Request body:**
```json
{
  "properties": {
    "pin": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pin"
    }
  },
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "pin"
  ],
  "title": "Body_unlock_api_lock_unlock_post"
}
```

## devices
### GET /api/devices
Devices

### PATCH /api/devices/{device_id}
Edit one device's label, icon, colour or tracked flag.

| name | in | required | type |
|---|---|---|---|
| device_id | path | True | string |

**Request body:**
```json
{
  "properties": {
    "label": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Label"
    },
    "icon": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Icon"
    },
    "color": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Color"
    },
    "tracked": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Tracked"
    }
  },
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DevicePatch",
  "description": "The editable fields of a device row.\n\nValidation lives in the model, not the route body, which is what makes\nFastAPI answer with api-contract.md's pinned\n`{\"detail\":[{\"loc\":[...],\"msg\":...}]}` shape. Raising an HTTPException from\nthe handler instead would produce `{\"detail\": \"<text>\"}` and break it."
}
```

### POST /api/devices/default
Set which device the dashboard focuses on first.

**Request body:**
```json
{
  "properties": {
    "device_id": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Device Id"
    }
  },
  "type": "object",
  "title": "Body_choose_default_api_devices_default_post"
}
```

### POST /api/devices/refresh
Re-query every authenticated provider for its device list.

### POST /api/devices/track
Replace the tracked set. `all_devices=true` tracks everything.

**Request body:**
```json
{
  "properties": {
    "device_ids": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Device Ids"
    },
    "all_devices": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "All Devices",
      "default": false
    }
  },
  "type": "object",
  "title": "Body_set_tracked_api_devices_track_post"
}
```

## history
### GET /api/days
Local dates holding data. Omit `device_id` for every device.

| name | in | required | type |
|---|---|---|---|
| device_id | query | False | string |
| timezone | query | False | string |

### GET /api/export
Export History

| name | in | required | type |
|---|---|---|---|
| fmt | query | False | string |
| day | query | False | string |
| start | query | False | string |
| end | query | False | string |
| device_id | query | False | string |
| group_id | query | False | string |
| timezone | query | False | string |

### GET /api/latest
Newest stored observation. Reads local history; does not query Google.

| name | in | required | type |
|---|---|---|---|
| device_id | query | False | string |
| timezone | query | False | string |

### GET /api/poll-runs
Poll Runs

| name | in | required | type |
|---|---|---|---|
| limit | query | False | integer |

### GET /api/timeline
One day of history, as one INDEPENDENT track per device.

| name | in | required | type |
|---|---|---|---|
| day | query | False | string |
| device_id | query | False | string |
| group_id | query | False | integer |
| movement_threshold_meters | query | False | number |
| gap_threshold_minutes | query | False | number |
| timezone | query | False | string |

### POST /api/history/clear
Delete ALL history, optionally for one device.

**Request body:**
```json
{
  "properties": {
    "confirm": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Confirm",
      "default": false
    },
    "device_id": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Device Id"
    }
  },
  "type": "object",
  "title": "Body_clear_history_api_history_clear_post"
}
```

### POST /api/history/delete-before
Delete observations older than a date. Requires explicit confirmation.

**Request body:**
```json
{
  "properties": {
    "before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Before",
      "description": "YYYY-MM-DD, local date"
    },
    "confirm": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Confirm",
      "default": false
    }
  },
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "before"
  ],
  "title": "Body_delete_before_api_history_delete_before_post"
}
```

### POST /api/poll-now
Trigger one immediate Find Hub query. Rate-limited to protect the account.
